editorial:
Imagine being a mean movie critic who hates everything, then accidentally walking into a support group for actual serial killers. That is exactly the mess Joel finds himself in. You get to watch this grumpy guy try to fake his way through a room full of murderers just to stay alive. The movie has a cool 80s vibe with bright colors and a dark sense of humor that makes the scary parts feel like a wild ride. It is a strange mix of a romantic comedy and a slasher flick, which keeps you guessing about what will happen next.

The acting is great, especially the way Joel panics while trying to sound like a killer. The pacing is quick, and the jokes land well, though some of the bloodier scenes might be too much for some. If you like dark humor and weird situations, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the vivid colors, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is a fun, quirky flick that does not take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: In the end, Joel manages to survive the chaos by using his wit and the help of a few unlikely allies. After a bloody showdown where the real killers turn on each other, Joel finally escapes the nightmare. The twist is that he actually finds a bit of love and growth through the madness. He stops being such a jerk and learns to appreciate life, though he is still the same sarcastic guy we love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and quirky horror movies.
